title: Dutch Stew with Spicy Nduja
description: A hearty and flavorful Dutch stew made with tender beef, spicy nduja sausage, and root vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef in batches until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the sliced nduja sausage to the pot and cook until browned, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, beef broth, red wine, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Return the browned beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until the beef is tender, about 2 1/2 hours.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
